servinfo.title: Release of Shorting Bar
servinfo.ptxt: Release shorting bar in SDM connector inserting release tool.

item.ptxt: To prevent accidental deployment of air bag during inspection, shorting bars are set in SDM connector (such as G12, L05, etc.). Therefore, before checking wiring harness connected to SDM for short to power supply, short to ground, short between two lines, release of corresponding shorting bar using special tool is necessary.
As an example, two connectors are shown in figure. When checking wiring harness related to DTC, it is necessary to release proper shorting bar referring to corresponding circuit diagram.
